createDialog.title: Add file/folder
createDialog.description: Choose a file or folder to back up.

exceedingAlert.title: Not enough cloud storage
exceedingAlert.description: This file or folder likely can’t be backed up because it would exceed your available CloudBlink storage. To back it up, you’ll need to upgrade your CloudBlink plan.

size.title: Calculate size
size.description: Estimate the size of this file or folder.

dropzone.title: Drop file/folder to add
dropzone.description: Drop a file or folder to add it to your vault and start backing it up.

alert.title: Cleanup happens over time
alert.description: Storage space won’t be freed instantly. BlinkDisk cleans up unused data later to ensure reliability.
